# ash_events v0.7.0 - Table of Contents

The extension for tracking changes to your resources via a centralized event log, with replay functionality.

## GUIDES

- [Home](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

- DSLs
  - [AshEvents.EventLog](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/dsl-ashevents-eventlog.md)
  - [AshEvents.Events](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/dsl-ashevents-events.md)

- About AshEvents
  - [Change Log](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [AshEvents.AdvisoryLockKeyGenerator](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.AdvisoryLockKeyGenerator.md):   Behaviour for generating advisory lock keys when inserting events for a given Ash-changeset.
  Must return a signed 64-bit integer, or two signed 32-bit integers in a list.

- [AshEvents.AdvisoryLockKeyGenerator.Default](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.AdvisoryLockKeyGenerator.Default.md): Default implementation of the `AshEvents.AdvisoryLockKeyGenerator` behaviour.
Handles the attribute-strategy for multitenancy, if the tenant value used is an
integer or uuid. For other scenarios, users must implemeent a custom implementation
and declare it in their event-log resource configuration.

- [AshEvents.ClearRecordsForReplay](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.ClearRecordsForReplay.md): Behaviour for clearing records from the event log.

- [AshEvents.CreateActionWrapper](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.CreateActionWrapper.md): Wrapper for create actions that enables event tracking.

- [AshEvents.DestroyActionWrapper](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.DestroyActionWrapper.md): Wrapper for destroy actions that enables event tracking.
- [AshEvents.EventLog](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.EventLog.md): Extension to use on the Ash.Resource that will persist events.

- [AshEvents.EventLog.Actions.Replay](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.EventLog.Actions.Replay.md): Action module used by the event log resource to replay events.

- [AshEvents.EventLog.Info](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.EventLog.Info.md): Introspection helpers for `AshEvents.EventLog`
- [AshEvents.EventLog.PersistActorPrimaryKey](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.EventLog.PersistActorPrimaryKey.md):   Adds a field (not relationship) on the event log resource that will be used to persist the actor primary key.

- [AshEvents.EventLog.Verifiers.VerifyActorResources](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.EventLog.Verifiers.VerifyActorResources.md): Verifies that persist_actor_primary_key entries reference valid Ash resources.
- [AshEvents.EventLog.Verifiers.VerifyAdvisoryLockConfig](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.EventLog.Verifiers.VerifyAdvisoryLockConfig.md): Verifies that advisory lock configuration is valid.
- [AshEvents.EventLog.Verifiers.VerifyClearRecordsForReplay](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.EventLog.Verifiers.VerifyClearRecordsForReplay.md): Verifies that the clear_records_for_replay configuration is valid.
- [AshEvents.EventLog.Verifiers.VerifyCloakVault](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.EventLog.Verifiers.VerifyCloakVault.md): Verifies that cloak_vault configuration is valid.
- [AshEvents.EventLog.Verifiers.VerifyPersistActorPrimaryKey](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.EventLog.Verifiers.VerifyPersistActorPrimaryKey.md): Verifies that when multiple persist_actor_primary_key options are defined,
they all have allow_nil? set to true.
- [AshEvents.EventLog.Verifiers.VerifyPublicAttributes](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.EventLog.Verifiers.VerifyPublicAttributes.md): Verifies that public_fields configuration contains valid attribute names.
- [AshEvents.EventLog.Verifiers.VerifyRecordIdType](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.EventLog.Verifiers.VerifyRecordIdType.md): Verifies that record_id_type configuration is valid.
- [AshEvents.EventLog.Verifiers.VerifyReplayOverrides](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.EventLog.Verifiers.VerifyReplayOverrides.md): Verifies that replay_overrides configuration is valid.
- [AshEvents.Events](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.Events.md): Defines the events section for a resource.

- [AshEvents.Events.ActionWrapperHelpers](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.Events.ActionWrapperHelpers.md): Helper functions used by the action wrappers.

- [AshEvents.Events.Changes.ApplyChangedAttributes](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.Events.Changes.ApplyChangedAttributes.md): A change that runs LAST during replay to apply changed_attributes.
- [AshEvents.Events.Changes.ApplyReplayPrimaryKey](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.Events.Changes.ApplyReplayPrimaryKey.md): A change that runs FIRST during replay to set the primary key.
- [AshEvents.Events.Info](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.Events.Info.md):   @moduledoc "Introspection helpers for `AshEvents.Events`"

- [AshEvents.Events.ReplayValidationWrapper](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.Events.ReplayValidationWrapper.md): Specialized wrapper for validations that preserves custom messages during event tracking.
- [AshEvents.Events.Validations.Never](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.Events.Validations.Never.md): A validation that always fails. Used as a `where` condition to create
non-executing changes that exist only for introspection by other libraries
(e.g., AshPhoenix nested form detection).

- [AshEvents.Events.Verifiers.VerifyActions](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.Events.Verifiers.VerifyActions.md): Verifies that action-related configuration is valid.
- [AshEvents.Events.Verifiers.VerifyEventLog](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.Events.Verifiers.VerifyEventLog.md): Verifies that the event_log configuration is valid.
- [AshEvents.Events.Verifiers.VerifyReplayNonInputAttributeChanges](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.Events.Verifiers.VerifyReplayNonInputAttributeChanges.md): Verifies that replay_non_input_attribute_changes configuration is valid.
- [AshEvents.Events.Verifiers.VerifyTimestamps](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.Events.Verifiers.VerifyTimestamps.md): Verifies that timestamp configuration is valid.
- [AshEvents.UpdateActionWrapper](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/AshEvents.UpdateActionWrapper.md): Wrapper for update actions that enables event tracking.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix ash_events.install](https://ash-events.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshEvents.Install.md): Installs AshEvents into a project. Should be called with `mix igniter.install ash_events`
